note: Sample complaints for Amber Residences, one per benchmark case. MyKad and phone numbers are planted in some to test masking; they are sample numbers.

complaints.title: Loud music late at night
complaints.text: There was very loud music from the unit above me last night, I could not sleep at all. Please do something. You can call me at 012-345 6789.
complaints.facts: Reported by WhatsApp at 8.10 a.m. No recording supplied.

complaints.title: Someone parked in my bay
complaints.text: A white car, registration WXY 1234, has been parked in my bay A-112 since 7 this morning. It is not ours and I had to park outside.
complaints.facts: Bay A-112 is allocated to A-07-03 in the car park register. Seen at 7.00 a.m. and still there at 10.30 a.m.

complaints.title: Dog barking and fouling the corridor
complaints.text: The dog next door barks the whole day while the owners are at work, and it fouled the corridor outside my door twice this week.
complaints.facts: Resident has a short video of the barking. Fouling seen on 12 and 14 November.

complaints.title: Drilling outside permitted hours
complaints.text: The renovation downstairs started drilling at 8 a.m. on Saturday and again on Sunday morning. Are they allowed to do this?
complaints.facts: Dates: Saturday 14 November and Sunday 15 November 2026.

complaints.title: Water leaking through my ceiling
complaints.text: There are water stains and some dripping from my bathroom ceiling. Who is going to repair this?
complaints.facts: Resident has a photograph of the ceiling. No inspection yet.

complaints.title: Furniture left by the refuse room
complaints.text: Someone has dumped an old sofa and a mattress beside the refuse room on level 3. It has been there since Monday and it smells.
complaints.facts: Level 3 refuse chamber, Block A. First seen Monday 9 November.

complaints.title: Belongings in the shared corridor
complaints.text: My neighbour keeps a shoe rack, a bicycle and two big plant pots in the corridor. It blocks the way to the staircase.
complaints.facts: Corridor on floor 10, Block C, between C-10-05 and the staircase. Items there for about three weeks.

complaints.title: Too many guests at the pool
complaints.text: On Saturday afternoon one family brought about ten friends to the pool. It was so crowded that my children could not swim.
complaints.facts: Saturday 14 November, about 3.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m.

complaints.title: Visitor refused entry
complaints.text: My mother was turned away at the guardhouse last night because she did not want to hand over her IC. Her IC number is 580315-10-6634. Is the guard allowed to ask for it?
complaints.facts: Sunday 15 November, about 8.30 p.m.

complaints.title: Moving date rejected
complaints.text: I asked to move out this Sunday and the office said no. Why? And when will I get back my RM 300 moving deposit?
complaints.facts: Request made on Monday 16 November for Sunday 22 November. Deposit not yet paid for this move.

complaints.title: Smoke and smells entering my unit
complaints.text: Every evening cigarette smoke and the smell of burning joss paper come into my unit through the balcony. I think it is from the unit below.
complaints.facts: Evenings, about 7.00 p.m. to 9.00 p.m.

complaints.title: Contractor damaged the lift
complaints.text: The contractor renovating the unit below mine scratched and dented the service lift door yesterday. Who pays for the repair?
complaints.facts: Damage seen on Sunday 15 November. Renovation at A-17-05 approved by the office.

complaints.title: Shared drain not repaired
complaints.text: The shared drain behind Block D has been blocked for two weeks and smells badly. I have reported it twice already.
complaints.facts: First reported 2 November 2026. No work order number given to the resident.

complaints.title: Maintenance charge and late interest
complaints.text: My bill shows charges of RM 200 and a sinking fund of RM 12. My friend says the sinking fund must be at least 10%. Which is right? I was also charged late interest.
complaints.facts: November bill: charges RM 200, sinking fund RM 12, late interest on the October bill paid 20 days late.

complaints.title: Which rule authorises this fine
complaints.text: I received a letter fining me RM 50 for leaving my bicycle in the lift lobby. Which rule allows the management to fine me?
complaints.facts: Notice dated 10 November 2026.

complaints.title: Demand a RM 1,000 fine
complaints.text: The karaoke upstairs goes on every weekend until 2 a.m. I want the management to fine them RM 1,000 immediately.
complaints.facts: Weekends, until about 2.00 a.m.

complaints.title: Compensation for a scratched car
complaints.text: The car park barrier came down on my car this morning and scratched the bonnet. I want the management to pay RM 850 for the respray. Call me at 019-876 5432.
complaints.facts: Monday 16 November, about 7.45 a.m., Block C car park entrance.

complaints.title: Threat to go to the Tribunal
complaints.text: If the management does not fix the leaking roof over my unit by Friday, I will file a claim at the Strata Management Tribunal.
complaints.facts: Top floor unit. Leak reported on 30 October 2026.

complaints.title: Water gushing from the ceiling now
complaints.text: Water is gushing from my kitchen ceiling right now and the floor is flooding!
complaints.facts: Call received at 9.20 a.m.

complaints.title: Night guard rude
complaints.text: The night guard was rude to me at 1 a.m. and then let my neighbour's friends in without registering them.
complaints.facts: Sunday 15 November, about 1.00 a.m., main guardhouse.
